name: Colorado PCB Assembly
old_description: Welcome to Colorado PCB ASSEMBLY: Your #1 PROTOTYPING and PCB Assembly Services Provider
about:
Colorado PCB Assembly operates from Centennial, Colorado, in the Denver Tech Center. The company describes itself as having decades of experience in quick-turn prototyping and assembly, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The shop specializes in low-volume, quick-turn PCB assembly, handling orders from a single board up to a few hundred units. Core processes include SMT assembly on automated pick-and-place machines, manual through-hole assembly, BGA placement with X-ray inspection, and full turnkey services that cover component sourcing, procurement, and kitting. Inspection and test capabilities encompass automated optical inspection (AOI), in-circuit testing (ICT), and functional testing. PCB fabrication—controlled-impedance, HDI, and multi-layer boards—is sourced through U.S.-based partner factories. Typical turnaround options range from one day to ten days.

Customers span telecommunications, LED lighting, automotive, medical, and consumer electronics sectors. The company cites engineers and designers developing prototypes or new-product introductions as its primary client base. A noted example is PantherTec, a human-performance wearable company that used Colorado PCB Assembly for its motion-capture sensor system.

The company states its mission is to deliver high-quality assembly that exceeds expectations at competitive prices while providing personalized service. It emphasizes a team-based workflow where the same personnel follow a build through every stage, and it highlights domestic production as a way to protect intellectual property and reduce shipping lead times.
